label: Text 1
transcript: "In Tokyo, lessons start at 8:30. The day is longer than ours. Students clean their classrooms every day. The break is shorter, but lunch is served at school. The school year is also longer than ours."

label: Text 2
transcript: "South African schools start their year in January. The summer holiday is in December. Many schools wear uniform. Lessons end earlier than in Germany, but afternoon clubs are common."
